description: Retrieves SCP domain routing information via HTTP GET on the "scp-domain-routing-info" resource, optionally with local=true to retrieve local SCP domain routing information.
normative_statements: The Service Consumer (i.e. SCP) shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI "scp-domain-routing-info" document resource.
On success, "200 OK" shall be returned with SCP Domain Routing Information in response body.
On failure, the NRF shall return "4xx/5xx" response and the response body may contain a ProblemDetails object describing the detailed information of the failure.

When SCPs are registered to multiple NRFs in the network, any NRF providing SCP domain routing information for the whole network shall retrieve the local SCP domain routing information in other NRF(s) and perform aggregation.
The Service Consumer (i.e. SCP) shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI "scp-domain-routing-info" document resource with "local" query parameter set to value "true".
On success, "200 OK" shall be returned with local SCP Domain Routing Information in response body.

constraints.statement: The SCP shall use HTTP GET for the "scp-domain-routing-info" resource request.
evidence: "The Service Consumer (i.e. SCP) shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI \"scp-domain-routing-info\" document resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the core method requirement and is directly testable by inspecting the request method.
